decisions.reason: As a flagship 2023 launch that extends a popular Demeter core line and remained promoted in 2024, it is likely meeting at least acceptable aspiration levels or is protected by strategic commitment and slack despite any early uncertainty.

This 2024 mild sliced cheese fits closely with the firm's established organic dairy capabilities and customer base, so an experienced German food producer would usually keep it on the market for longer unless results clearly fell below aspirations.

The 2024 sliced butter cheese is also highly related to the firm's existing cheesemaking resources and distribution, and with only limited time to judge performance the firm would likely continue it while monitoring whether it reaches aspiration levels.
